evaluation: Run identical task inputs with and without the skill; blindly grade on relevance, buyer evidence, author fidelity, denied claims, prohibited constructions, and exact user constraint compliance. Do not claim efficacy from this fixture alone.

tests.prompt: Profile has redundant paragraphs, substantiated achievements and unclear call to action.
expect: Edit by separate argument, factual, specificity, reader, voice, structure and friction passes; preserve evidence

tests.prompt: Existing copy describes a project as a $100M deployment without source.
expect: Request proof or narrow claim, do not invent number

tests.prompt: User requests removal of a single repeated phrase.
expect: Correct narrowly, maintain all surrounding accepted content

tests.prompt: Sentence is grammatical but no buyer can identify how the firm differs.
expect: Escalate to positioning; do not solve by adjectives
